article.story: HAMDEN, Conn. -- — Amarri Monroe's 20 points helped Quinnipiac defeat Iona 79-74 on Sunday. Monroe also contributed 10 rebounds for the Bobcats (16-10, 12-3 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Jaden Zimmerman added 16 points while shooting 7 for 12 and had five rebounds. Doug Young finished with 15 points. Dejour Reaves led the way for the Gaels (11-15, 8-7) with 15 points, six rebounds, four assists and six steals. Justin Menard added 13 points for Iona. Luke Jungers also recorded 12 points, three steals and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
